title: Sanger Tree of Life HMW DNA Fragmentation: Covaris g-TUBE for ULI PacBio
author: Graeme Oatley

steps.title: Prepare g-TUBEs
steps.instruction: Label the required number of Covaris g-TUBEs for each DNA sample on both the lid and the bottom.

steps.title: Prepare DNA Sample
steps.instruction: Mix the DNA sample by pipetting carefully with a wide-bore pipette tip.

steps.title: Transfer DNA to g-TUBEs
steps.instruction: Transfer 100–150 µL of the DNA sample (150 µL is ideal) to the corresponding labelled g-TUBE.

substeps.instruction: If processing multiple samples, normalize volumes to be equal by adding EB buffer.
Ensure the time between transfer and centrifugation is no longer than 15 minutes to prevent sample migration into the filter on the bench.

steps.title: Seal g-TUBEs
steps.instruction: Tightly seal the screw-caps using the provided g-TUBE prep station.

steps.title: First Centrifugation Cycle
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the g-TUBEs to pass the sample through the filter.

substeps.instruction: Place g-TUBEs in a bench-top centrifuge, balancing with a spare g-TUBE if necessary.
Run for 1 minute at 5,000 rpm for a 10 kb shear size (refer to manufacturer's instructions for other sizes).
Repeat centrifugation up to three times until all volume has passed through the filter.
Check the tube between chambers to ensure the sample has passed through; if not passed after three spins, refer to Troubleshooting.

steps.title: Second Centrifugation Cycle
steps.instruction: Pass the DNA through the filter a second time.

substeps.instruction: Invert the g-TUBEs in the prep station so the fixed base faces up and the screw-cap faces down.
Repeat the centrifugation and filtration process (as described in the first cycle) so the DNA passes through the filter a total of two times.

steps.title: Recover Sheared DNA
steps.instruction: Extract the processed DNA from the g-TUBEs.

substeps.instruction: Remove g-TUBEs from the centrifuge maintaining the screw-cap down orientation and place them in the prep station.
Carefully unscrew the tube from the lid, leaving the lid in the prep station for stability.
Aspirate the sample from the screw-cap using a standard pipette tip.
Transfer the sheared DNA to a fresh DNA Lo-Bind microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Store the sheared DNA at 4 °C until further processing.
